title: valeriana alternifolia var. angustifolia
intro: Valeriana alternifolia var. angustifolia, commonly known as the narrowleaf valerian, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Valerianaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from anxiety and insomnia due to its numerous health benefits, including its sedative and antispasmodic effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to interact with the nervous system, promoting relaxation, reducing stress, and alleviating muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include valepotriates, isovaleramide, and valerenic acid, which contribute to its sedative, anxiolytic, and spasmolytic effects.
